name: Captain Kick and the Cowboy Ramblers

podcast.title: Large Bluegrass Ensemble
podcast.body: Winston Marshall's Bluegrass group featured up to 16 members. They performed covers of artists ranging from The Grateful Dead, Neil Young, and Dexys Midnight Runners to Shania Twain, and played at a small 40-person bar in London called The Bosens Locker. "His sort of Bluegrass group was called Captain Kick and the Cowboy Ramblers, and it had up to 16 members."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Marcus Mumford's Career Path Change
xref.body: After attending Captain Kick and the Cowboy Ramblers' performance at The Bosens Locker, Marcus Mumford was so impressed that he dropped out of Edinburgh University, where he was expected to follow his parents into the ministry, and committed to music as his vocation. "Marcus was so impressed by what he heard and saw that he dropped out of university and vowed to make music his vocation."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
